name: nutrition-service
description: Looks up nutrition facts (calories, macros) for recipes and logged foods, so recipes and food logs carry accurate nutrition data.

suggestions.name: USDA FoodData Central
suggestions.description: Free, no commercial licensing, US government nutrient database — good default for a broad food catalog.

suggestions.name: Edamam Nutrition Analysis API
suggestions.description: Commercial API with recipe-level nutrition analysis and a large branded-food database.

suggestions.name: Nutritionix
suggestions.description: Commercial API with strong natural-language food logging and a large branded/restaurant database.
